notes.title: A New Update for Detached is here!
notes.notes:
We are over the moon to announce that a brand-new update for ​​​Detached​​​ is now available! 

[previewyoutube=5t8MRGsebK8;full][/previewyoutube]

This isn’t just any update—it’s a labour of love for one of our very first projects, a game that holds a special place in our hearts 💙

When we first launched Detached, we set out to create an unforgettable zero-gravity adventure, immersing players in the vastness of space. Over the years, technology has evolved, and we felt it was time to revisit this cosmic journey and bring it up to speed with the latest advancements.

Here’s what’s new in this update:

✨ Expanded Headset Compatibility
We’ve opened the airlocks to welcome more players aboard! Detached now supports a wider range of headsets, so even more space explorers can experience the thrill of navigating the cosmos.
👉 The game supports now Oculus Quest 2/3, Pico 4 Pro/Ultra, Valve Index, and HTC Vive.
Note: Windows Mixed Reality (WMR) is no longer supported due to compatibility issues with the latest Windows 10 and Windows 11 updates.

✨ Updated Default Control Scheme
Piloting your ship has never felt smoother. We’ve fine-tuned the controls to ensure they’re perfectly aligned with the capabilities of the latest headsets.
👉 Improved FXP control scheme for Oculus Quest 2/3, Valve Index, and Pico 4 Pro/Ultra. ​​

✨ Bug Fixes and Stability Improvements
We’ve patched up some cracks in the hull to ensure your journey through the void is as seamless as possible.
👉 Resolved a crash issue caused by OpenSSL 1.0.2 in Unreal Engine 4.19 on Intel 10th Gen+ processors. The game now uses the updated fix from Unreal Engine 4.22, ensuring smoother performance.

This update is our way of saying thank you to all the players who have joined us on this interstellar adventure over the years. Whether you’re a seasoned astronaut or a new recruit, we hope this update rekindles your love for the game and reminds you of the wonder of exploring the unknown.

So, suit up, power up your thrusters, and prepare to dive back into the breathtaking world of Detached. The stars are calling, and your ship is ready 🌌

─────────────────────────────────────────────
🎮 Follow Anshar Publishing on Steam 🎮

notes.title: Detached Major Update #05 – Valve Index Supported!
notes.notes:
No calibration needed – we’ve heard you and did what we promised. The latest update to Detached brings a lot of news in terms of steering and compatibility. Read more below:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11726899/f685df58e4ce7ca2fe2fc11cb30b0a0fd0f96266.png

Added Valve Index suport
First of all, we’ve added the Valve Index support many of you were asking for. The Valve Index Knuckles controllers are now fully supported. This means you don’t have to force it to be identified as a different set of VR devices just to make it run properly.

Redesigned onboarding sequence
A new onboarding sequence is designed to brief players about the game's possible controls and movement options. So yeah, basically, we’ve made a better and more clear tutorial to help players choose the best movement settings that suit their style.

https://media.giphy.com/media/s8bc6YBFjLryc2b0wN/giphy.gif

Added binding graphics in options
Some of you made us aware that the controls are not as clear as we hoped, so we've added some graphics with the layout of the control settings to be previewed in the options.

Added action names in SteamVR binding settings & localized them properly.
This required a fix, and these actions are now displayed correctly. We've made sure they are well-localized and unified so it won't cause any confusion.

Fixed disabling pause menu with left thumbstick
It's what it is. You can exit the pause menu by simply pressing the left thumbstick. This might become handy when you accidentally enter the menu and want a quick evacuation route. 😉

 It's been a long journey, but the wait is over – you can now fully appreciate the feeling of being alone in Space! See you out there, astronauts! Next week, we will have a little surprise for you. Be sure to follow us to not miss the announcement!

notes.title: Detached [PS VR and Non-VR Edition launch] + Update #04
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/IXqlzN6.png

Hey!

PS VR & Non-VR Edition available now

We are coming back to you with the long-awaited announcement. Today, Detached has its premiere at the PlayStation Store. Players can now start the fight for survival in space and zero-G environment, which was previously reserved entertainment only for Oculus Rift and HTC Vive owners.

On the occasion of the premiere we have for you an additional premiere trailer of the game, which you can watch on our YouTube channel:

Check out the latest trailer

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=knPOqB9EW_I

Update #04 - Cross-platform PvP and Epilogue level

Why is it worth being interested in the premiere of the game for other consoles? According to previous information on Steam, Detached version on Steam today receives many improvements and news! Here is what we have prepared for you:

https://i.imgur.com/mSsR5sV.png

- New map for Race mode and PvP cross-platform. Finally, players can fight on four maps, two for each mode. The most important thing, however, is that players with Oculus Rift and HTC Vive goggles can participate in multiplayer games, as well as owners of PS VR equipment, as well as ... Non-VR Edition available in the Steam store after this link (along with the free demo to download)

- Support for Windows Mixed Reality devices - We meet the requests of players who have opted for alternative virtual reality devices. The update makes the new devices with the WMR system compatible with Detached.

- New content for single player mode - Discover the alternative ending of history thanks to a new ending in the game! Players receive nearly an hour of new content, along with achievements to gain. What will you do when the enemy cruiser intercepts your capsule and every move in the room captures the cannon? Prove that you are able to get out of any oppression, and advanced EVA suit modules are your best friends.

See the full list of changes below!

https://i.imgur.com/MX88Zfa.jpg

If you want to learn more about Detached game, visit the game website or follow us on Twitter or Facebook. Feel free to contact us!

Facebook
Twitter

notes.title: Detached with cross-platform PvP mode and a non-VR version on July 6th
notes.notes:
Hello space scavengers!

Finally, we can announce to you a long-kept secret. Detached receives the Cross-Platform PvP multiplayer, thanks to which you can play with the players regardless of the device they have. The optimized multi-player mode offers two game modes for players who have Oculus Rift, HTC Vive, PlayStation VR and... PC version!

Too good to be true? Watch the most honest trailer in the history of the game trailers and see for yourself! 

https://youtu.be/71Vu1F3Bae4

Cross-Platform PvP // Non-VR version

We didn't make a mistake! Detached will come in a non-VR version on Steam exactly on July 6th, as well as a version for PlayStation VR. Soon, there will also be a free desktop demo available, where you'll be able to see what the extreme space game looks like without using VR goggles! However, this is not all news for today.

Expanded single player mode

As mentioned earlier, Detached will receive more maps for Race mode, and the single player story mode will be extended by an additional 30 minutes of gameplay. Another sneak peak from the place where there is an impassable stronghold can be found below. How can you get out of the middle of an enemy ship, in which danger is hitting on every corner?

https://media.giphy.com/media/7NXupc9gzV84aPzdl7/giphy.gif

So get your spacesuits, VR headsets, and PCs ready for an epic space rivalry that blasts off on July 6th this year.

notes.title: Detached PS VR version - New content also on PC!
notes.notes:
Last Friday we informed you about the release of Detached for PlayStation 4, which was scheduled for July 5! In case you've missed it, check out our PS VR Announcement Trailer below! 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kn57MPar08M
Players with PS VR will be able to feel the amazing freedom in space and fight for survival in the difficult circumstances without oxygen and fuel supplies. Detached has received from PC players lot of positive feedback, for which almost a year after the initial premiere we would like to thank you all once again!

A new level on the enemy's land! 

Why is it worth paying attention to the upcoming premiere? The port for the Sony console is not the only novelty we have prepared for you. PC players can also expect new content in both single player and multiplayer modes! Below we present the first screenshot from the new location, which each of you will have the opportunity to visit. 

Here, dangers lurk around every corner. Avoiding contact with hostile drones is almost impossible. Be cunning and find a way out of a place that could easily capture your rescue capsule, which was supposed to be a salvation for you. Can you guess what this place is?

https://i.imgur.com/vXLIyNe.png

Keep up-to-date with our next articles, where we'll be able to inform you about the upcoming features!

notes.title: Detached - Update #03 - Race mode
notes.notes:
Challenge your friend in the new Race mode and fly for victory! The latest Detached update is now available on Steam and Oculus store.

Introducing Race mode

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Tsnvf-nyOq8

Race mode will meet the expectations of players who have mastered the control of the advanced EVA suit to perfection. Racing among the destroyed spaceship is extremely challenging, and the smallest error can cost a fortune (or your life). Prove that you are the one who rules this part of the space rift! In addition to challenging environment, you have to focus on your opponent who is just waiting for your mistake. A moment of inattention is enough to counterattack… but if you are skilled enough, you can use the boost module to get out of trouble! 

http://i.imgur.com/1iKMY3d.jpg

Leaderboards; New private lobby

The best players will be included in the leaderboards available in all game modes (Package Extraction, Race and Single Player campaign).
Creating a game and joining the game is no longer a problem in the private lobby, where you can choose the right control scheme and game mode.

Simulation mode

In addition new difficulty level awaits all space exploration lovers – space conditions have never been so realistic! Simulation mode is a bow to the most passionate fans of space travel, for which weightlessness is no stranger. Carefully use the thrusters to correct the flight path and find out if you have what it takes to become an astronaut!

The following image contains more informations about the latest update.

http://i.imgur.com/LsBYISx.jpg

In case of any questions related to the new content, feel free to start a new discussion on Detached forum here on Steam.

Remember to follow the Detached on social media channels! You will find us on:

notes.title: Detached - Update #02 [Gold 1.0.6343]
notes.notes:
Hi!

We’re coming back to you with Update #02! We hope that the exploration of outer space in Detached is an unforgettable experience for you. Finding salvation in tough conditions is not that easy, is it? Fortunately, many of you have proven that you have a great predisposition to become a full-time astronaut!

Eagle Eye View

https://media.giphy.com/media/3oKIPc2QwJIoqB3E9W/giphy.gif

The latest update focuses on the single player mode enhancements that you have reported on the Detached Steam forum. Primarily we added Eagle Eye View mode. New function is a response to the players request who are sensitive to the game intense experience. Eagle Eye View will minimize extreme gameplay thanks to the limited field of view. The option can be automatically activated by selecting one of the available difficulty levels or by accessing it directly from the settings in the game menu. 


New language - Chinese

In addition, Rednezvous level has received several enhancements. We also added a new language to the game – Chinese. Full update notes can be found below:

https://i.imgur.com/lFIfyO9.jpg

Thanks a lot for your activity! As promised, we are still working on multiplayer mode improvements. Stay tuned for more information! Remember to follow the Detached on social media channels. You will find us on:
- Facebook
- Twitter
- Instagram
- YouTube
- detachedgame.com

In case of problems with the game, post a new thread on Detached Steam forum in technical support subforum.

notes.title: Detached is available now! [Full Release]
notes.notes:
It's happening! Detached launches today on the HTC Vive and Oculus Rift!

Watch Official Launch Trailer

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CGecTrjiRh0

"How can you avoid sickness in VR? Well, there are a couple of solutions… but the most important are having an iron stomach and the stamina of a hardcore player. Are you one of the few who can endure the challenges of hyper-realistic virtual space?"

The extremely atmospheric environment allows you to experience the intense immersive feeling that comes with VR devices, giving you extraordinary sensations. On top of that, players using the HTC Vive and Oculus Rift can count on full controller support, further enhancing the gameplay experience.
Challenge a friend to Detached’s PvP mode and have fun outsmarting them! This variation on the popular capture-the-flag mode will test your control skills and challenge you to outwit your enemy with the advanced abilities of the EVA suit.


    The game features English, German, Polish and French localization (texts) and offers controller support for Oculus Rift and HTC Vive.
    Several control systems are available for each controller; The arcade mode includes a flight assistant, and for even greater convenience you can enable soft collisions to correct your flight path and avoid collision.
     Single-player mode has been enhanced with the new levels and features, which were not available in Early Access.
      Multiplayer mode will also receive an additional map, short after the game release

Stay tuned for more updates. Enter The Space now! 

---

We invite you to ask questions in the forum and share your experiences with the game. Also in case of problems publish new thread in Technical Support section.

Once again we remind you that Detached is an extreme VR experience that simulates sudden and dramatic acceleration, freefalling, twisting, and rolling. Even at 90 fps, it is not for VR-sensitive players!

For more information about Detached, visit: Steam Page,

Follow Detached on:
Facebook, Twitter, Instagram,

http://detachedgame.com/

notes.title: Detached Story Teaser I Release Date Announcement (PC VR)
notes.notes:
It's here! Watch Detached Story Teaser! 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5tfZBZva_1s

Detached PC VR launch date is set for 18/05/17 with HTC Vive and Oculus Rift support. Play the Early Access version of the game now!

Things did not happen according to plan. Then again - out here, nothing ever does. Easy salvage operation took a quite unexpected turn. The truth is, in a vast cosmic space you have to be prepared for whatever comes your way. And for the fact, that whoever you encounter – they are not your friends…

You are dropped at the edge of a universe destroyed by human misrule and extortion. Thanks to years of warfare and greed, the human colonies in deep space are no more. The great factions have crumbled; the corrupt corporations have dissolved. You have to race against borrowed time to find your crew before your oxygen supply runs out. But this is only the beginning…

notes.title: Content Update #3 is live now!
notes.notes:
The third content update for Early Access includes long awaited support for Oculus Touch controllers. Put down your gamepad on the side and feel even greater immersion during space exploration! We also spent a lot of time with collision system, which has been greatly improved. We have not forgotten about minor tweaks like new checkpoint list, new resources model and changes in the first tutorial hub. All improvements are highlighted below.
